name: Craftsman's Writ: Flash Bomb
summary: A transferable writ requests one Flash Bomb from a customer. The note calls for delivery to a marked location and information about payment.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: A faded note requests one Flash Bomb, with a delivery place and payment information. The writ can be transferred, but you need to hold it to complete the exchange. The marked location is shown on your map.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Flash Bomb, along with information about delivery and payment.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: You need the writ in your possession and the requested item, then deliver it to the location marked on your map.
